profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
I am a Software Engineer specializing in Java and Spring Boot to support backend e-commerce services. My skillset also includes Python, AWS Lambda and S3, SQL, Splunk, Redis, JavaScript, React.js, HTML, CSS, and SparkPost.

In my current role as a Software Engineer at the Walt Disney Company, I have worked on the cart checkout and calendar reservation system for Disney Parks. In addition to refactoring and building new functionality into our backend services, my other responsibilities include reviewing data contracts with handler services, preparing analytics through Splunk dashboards, working with QA to validate scope requirements for testing, and performing code reviews. 

I am personally interested in microservice architecture design and building scalable systems. I enjoy solving complex puzzles and I value team oriented environments with strong collaboration across UI/service/product/QA teams. As I continue to grow as a software engineer, one of my goals is to become a mentor for new software developers as well.

Feel free to connect with me on LinkedIn!

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
+ Leverage Java and Spring Boot on delivery-focused team to enhance and support 10+ backend microservices powering the Disneyland and Disney World Cart and Checkout and ticketing reservation pages

+ Work with sustainment teams to ensure a smooth handover of projects, and led a solo project to develop a Python Lambda responsible for querying 90-100k rows of data and integrated with EventBridge to periodically upload to AWS S3 for offline access

+ Built Splunk dashboards to quickly triage production issues, extracting data from different backend service calls to visually highlight errors and failures from downstream service calls

+ Handle integration between order service, payment transaction processing and product handler services, ensuring support for fraud-prevention, payment option selection, pricing display, and sending of confirmation emails for completed orders

+ Perform routine code reviews, participate in the design of sequence diagrams and data contracts, collaborate with UI/product stakeholders/QA and with external teams, train juniors, and manage the implementation of coding solutions with feature level ambiguity
positions.insights: Skills: Spring Boot · Splunk · SQL · Java · AWS Lambda

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
+ Built interactive web pages using React.js and HTML/CSS for the independent student newspaper of the University of Maryland

+ Oversaw maintenance of the salary guide database, which provides transparency about UMD employee salaries
positions.insights: Skills: JavaScript · React.js · HTML · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS)

positions.title: Graphic Designer
positions.description:
+ Work with Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop, and Procreate to design custom marketing materials for social events, student outreach programs, and social media campaigns

+ Mediate design direction between various stakeholders, and participate in weekly critique sessions with other members of the STAMP Marketing team

+ Designed original campaign materials for Black History Month 2021, Multiracial Heritage Month 2021, and Asian American Pacific Islander Heritage Month 2021

+ Designs can be found via the UMD STAMP Instagram (https://www.instagram.com/thestampumd/)

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
+ Leveraged AWS and S3 to design a lambda function using Python to automate testing for 10 API responses across testing environments, in order to streamline validation processes

+ Refactored the configuration structure and Python code of a commonly used lambda, and reduced config file sizes by over 50%
positions.insights: Skills: Amazon S3 · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · AWS Lambda · Python (Programming Language)

volunteerExperiences.description:
+ Design UI elements, social media posts, and animations for the world's largest hackathon for underrepresented genders
+ Built Figma components for hacker platform pages including registration, help desk, and home
+ Designed website icons to display different tracks hackers can register for
+ Reviewed user experience and workflow of the entire platform through card sorting user feedback
+ Created graphics for marketing packages and animations for the fifth anniversary video, which has surpassed 18,000 views on the official Technica Facebook page

+ Lead the Bitcamp 2021 design team in running an online hackathon experience, along with two design specific events: Design Den and Colorwar
+ Lead a team of UI/UX designers in redesigning components of a hacker platform to adhere to Bitcamp style guidelines and general UI/UX principles (using Figma)
+ Worked closely with the marketing team to plan social media posts and campaigns
+ Worked with the development team to redesign the Bitcamp platform and main Bitcamp website
+ Participated in judging the best UI/UX hack at Bitcamp
